blocks.text: THE SEVENFOLD POWER AND MANIFESTATIONS OF THE SEVEN CHURCH AGES— “Jesus gave each Church Age a promise” (Rev. 2:1, 7) 1st the Church at Ephesus the (manifestation) he was walking in the midst of 7 golden candlesticks. The Promise the “Tree of Life.” (Rev. 2:8, 10) 2nd Smyrna Church, (Manifestation) the first and the last, Promise “The Crown of Life” — 3rd. Pergamos Church (Rev. 2:12, 17) manifestation a sharp two edged sword, the promise, “a new name” written in white stone” and “hidden manna” incidently it was this Church Age where they discovered and invented scroll (Parchment), (the old way was skin rolls) 4th. Church Thyatira (Rev. 2:18, 26-28) manifestation, eyes like unto a flaming fire, the promise, power over nations like rod of iron. And I will give him the Morning Star! 5th. Sardis Church (Rev. 3:1, 5) manifestation the 7 spirits of God, the promise, “clothed with white raiment”! 6th. Church, Philadelphia, (Rev. 3:7, 8, 12) manifestation, He is Holy and true, the promise “the key of David. “And will make him a pillar in the Temple of God!” An open door and the new name of God written upon the elect! The 7th. Church Laodicea, The “Amen” standing on the outside. (Rev. 3:14, 21) manifestation the beginning of the creation of God, the promise, the overcomer will sit in His throne. But He states in verse 16 and 17 that He will spue the rest out of His mouth! Most of these in this last rich church that do get in, “go through Tribulation”. Finally the 7th. Church Age completely apostatizes into world system! Right at this point Jesus begins to separate the wheat from the tares. (Matt. 13:30) Jesus is outside and now He pours all the above power and promises and manifestations into the sons of God. “And unto the elect” the beginning of new things, (the promise) the 7th. Seal prophecy of the 7th. Angel’s message! “the manifestation” secrets revealed in the Thunders!). They receive a new song, a new name in stone, and the new name of God! And a new rainbow message (complete revelation of God) but the 7th. Church Age Laodicea (Rey. 3:14-15) does not receive this, because they are spued out! But the Bride receives a message (secrets) out of His mouth. (Rev. 10:4) God’s Headstone (7th Seal) message is saved and goes to His elect. THUS SAITH THE LORD! Thunder is associated with harvest (I Sam. 12:16, 17, 18) Yea, A PROPHET STEPS OUT OF THE SUN INTO MY RAINBOW ANOINT- ING! A “revelator” wrapped in lightning (Rev. 10:4-7) A Lion! “who shall be able to stand’? All four powers in Rev. 4:7 representing the past messengers will be mixed in one servant at the end producing rainbow prophet (Rev. 10 - -Thunders) — the power that went to the 7 Church Ages and Messengers will be combined together poured on the Bride, unleashing 7 Lamps of light Producing translative faith, giving birth to the Man Child. In Rev. 5 — the Lamb with the Book was a witness to the entire world, but the 7th. Seal is a book of Prophecy, the lion roars and it is written in the Thunder! The Silent Seal is a quick short work! One can see God placed the 7th. Seal away from the other Six Seals! (Rev. 6:1-12) Then He skips a chapter and He starts in “Rev. 8:1” It is separated from Lukewarm churches and is revealed to His elect. It is written mystery rolls! In Rev. 5 it was a book, but in 10:1-7 it’s called “Little Book” (Little seals, message to “little group”, the elect! Verse 7 reads in the days of the voice (prophecy) of the 7th. Angel the mysteries of God should be finished! He deliberately separates the 7th. Seal (the same as He will His elect) and does it in (Rev. 10). The Headstone message does not go to the Organizations! The little group believe it! Behold saith He with the flaming eyes, these sayings are true!”’ (After Rev. 8:1 silence) we see the first 6 Trumpets have minor judgments (verse 6-13, Rey. 9:13) but the 7th. Trumpet has “7 last deadly plagues” starting in Rev. 11:15 and ends in Rev. 16:1-17) Also each of the 7 Church Ages had partial (minor) power given unto them, “but the 7th. Seal contains and revolves into the 7 Thunders of power to His elect’! These secrets were silent, but now are being revealed! The 7th. Seal was so important no symbols were given just “silence”! All the church systems finish in 7 plagues connected to Rome, But the elect receive “7 Lamps anointing” connected to Christ! — The 7th. Seal, The 7 Thunders and the 7th. Angel go together with the little book at hee Seals, are like the sntee Ee 1 te Ee é Re cite ane: the De copatore of, ee only a few would be raised right after this. But at the end numerous cases prone be in the latter rain finally joining the resurrection of dead saints!
THE APPOINTED DUTY OF THE SUN— The sun is the “head” or the “capstone” of the heavens wherein it holds the

heavenly bodies in place by it’s magnetic force, else the planets be hurled apart! The sun of righteousness the headstone (Christ) will now hold the heavenly bodies (elect) together by magnetic power else they be scattered in every direction! We see all through the Bible and in Revelations He used the word Sun, connected to Him! (I was born during the “midday sun” July 23, 33 — (Acts. 26:13 — Rev. 1:16)

THE DESCRIPTIVE AND VARIOUS APPEARANCES OF OUR LORD— God appeared to Noah after the flood as the covenant angel (rainbow redeemer) (Gen. 9:13-14) To Moses He appeared in the burning bush (a divine deliverer) He appeared to Moses in fire, smoke, lightning! To Joshua He appeared as the Captain of the Host with a drawn sword. (a spiritual war Lord for Israel “The sun and the moon stopped” (the stone with 7 eyes (Zech. 3:9) — To Abraham He appeared as the Son of Man in human form as the messenger spirit! (St. John 8:56-57) He appeared in Michael as the commander against satan, when satan contended for the body of Moses (Jude 1:9) He said the Lord rebuke thee! Jesus shows me the secret of Michael. (Zech. 3:2) — He appeared to Elijah as a God of fire, a small voice and a whirlwind. To Samuel a small voice and with Thunder. (I Sam. 12:17, 18) Daniel saw Him in Michael’s form after intervening for Him with Gaberiel. He was clothed in linen, His body as beryle, His face the appearance of lightning, His eyes like lamps of fire, His arms and feet like polished brass, His voice as a multitude. An intervener, a warrior of truth! (Dan. 10:5, 6, 13, 21) — Concerning Michael there is only “God” who can be called the “great prince”, Amen — Dan, 12:1) — In Job an awesome God of mercy, he felt His spirit and his hair stood up! (Job. 4:15) — To the Hebrew children in the fiery furnace He appeared as “‘son” the protector in tribulation fire, the same way He will appear to the Jews at the end! (Dan. 3:25) Daniel also saw Him as He (God) looked in the very beginning! As the ancient of days! The all powerful judge! His garment as white as snow! His hair like pure wool! His throne a living flame! His wheels a burning fire! He could appear anywhere suddenly, divine and fixed authority! He has the Books, He owns all and sits a King the wise judge. (Dan. 7:9) John saw Him as the revelator in Hin midst of the 7 golden candelsticks, clothed in fire as the noon day sun, John fell as dead! (Rev. 1:13-17) He saw Him in many forms. He saw Him “as one” on the throne, with a rainbow and stone (Rev. 4:2, 3) He saw Him in thunder and lightning, He saw Him in Rev. 10 as the messenger, in a cloud, as a clothed revelator wrapped in deity plus angelic form, with a message which set in motion the 7 Thunders! He appears in the last Gentile messenger as the Pillar of Fire (Revelator) It’s just a little book but Jesus type of appearance makes it the most important of the ages! “A covenant message’’, the redeemer! He appears to His elect in dramatic fashion covered with all the wisdom of the ages! Yet all this is connected to a “Little Book” rolls! Ezekiel saw Him in a whirlwind, with amber fire in wheels, glory and blazing light! He and Daniel both saw Him as a living emanating creator vibrating and magnetic! All these manifestations and power will be behind the “Sons of God” at the end! “I am the living light and I appear as it pleaseth Me and not men! I am the ancient one, remove
not these words lest ye remove your own self from the kingdom of the Most High! For it is He who writeth and speaketh unto thee!”

BEHOLD I LAY A CHIEF CORNERSTONE IN THE USA— (CAPSTONE) — THE RAINBOW ELECT OF GOD — “house of the man Child” — These shall rule the nations with a rod of iron. “And unto the angel “messenger” at Capstone (apostle at midnight) write these things to the true and faithful (the elect) “Blessed are they which are called and shall eat of the manna hidden in rolls! “Behold the time is at hand and I have thy reward (crown) saith the living God! — Blessed is the first and the last, Jesus Christ the creation of God, the beginning and the end, the Great I am, “the Amen” — it is written by My servant on rolls and in My Word the hour is soon! “And the heavens departed as a scroll” (Rey. 6:14) — The sun sets in the West over “Capstone” House (Temple) and as the lightning shineth from the East Even unto the West so shall the coming of the Son of Man be! (Matt. 24:27).

THE HUMAN EYE IS LIKE A SEAL WHEN IT IS CLOSED— when it is open one sees vision and revelations in front of him! The little eye above the Pyramid (on USA currency) is open and the lines depict writing is involved! You can see the little lines in rolls above the eye! The open eye shows it will be something read! “It says Great Seal below the circle! — There were 7 messengers that went to the 7 Church Ages we just spoke of — But the 7th. Angel as the “time” messenger goes to the elect Man Child — the “little eye seal”! Thus Saith the living God! — (I am not writting Extra Bible only fullfilling it!) — I did not try to exalt or repeat myself on purpose during the last (Sers.) But Jesus wanted it to be understood and plainer.
